Lecture Notes

  • Foundations & REST Basics

    The Node.js runtime, Express fundamentals, and building GET/POST /tickets against an in-memory store.

  • Data Modeling & Persistence

    Relational modeling in Prisma, migrations and seeding against MySQL, and swapping the in-memory ticket store for real Prisma queries.

  • Full CRUD REST API

    Zod validation, consistent response/error conventions, full CRUD with nested comment routes, filtering/sorting/pagination, and unit tests that grow alongside the code.

  • Auth & Authorization

    bcrypt password hashing, JWT login/register, and role-based middleware that scopes what customers, agents, and admins can each see and do.

  • Events & Notifications

    Domain events decouple side effects — an in-app notification, an email, and a live Socket.IO push — from the controller code that triggers them.
